title: Runtime closing report for a worktree whose content basis is permanently refused (e.g. gitlinks) is retained and retried instead of being settled with a reason
outcome: When the closing source of a turn cannot ever be measured because the basis is refused definitively, not transiently, the runtime closing delivery is settled once. It is delivered with an explicit unmeasured-source reason, or retired with that reason. It is not kept and retried indefinitely. Transient measurement failures keep today's retry.
acceptance: A definitive content-basis refusal (for example a gitlink without submodule support, or a Git filter or LFS) at closing settles the runtime closing delivery once, with the refusal reason recorded and visible; it is not retried on later turns.
A transient measurement failure (for example a deadline or a racy capture) keeps the existing retained-and-retried behaviour; tests distinguish the two cases.
The local Test Runs row and the declared artifact verdict are unchanged in both cases.
